description:
Shown in the suburb report as the breakdown table inside the 'Crime' card in
the Risks section.

Per-crime-type rates (predicted incidents per 100,000 residents
per year) for the suburb vs national medians. Each row is the median over
the suburb's mesh blocks for that crime type, so the rows do not add up to
the `suburb_median` on `/crime/summary` (a median of totals).

**Price: 10¢ per call.**
name: suburbs_crime_breakdown
title: Suburb · Crime — breakdown by type
